title: Forest Witch's Enchanted Desk
description: A purple-haired witch in a green velvet robe sits at a moss-covered wooden desk inside an enchanted forest. She holds a crystal ball in one hand and a quill in the other, surrounded by potion bottles, spell books, glowing lanterns, and scattered magical ingredients.
prompt: A beautiful witch with purple hair and red feather ornaments wearing an ornate green robe sits at a large mossy wooden desk inside a glowing enchanted forest. She holds a glowing crystal orb and a red quill over a bowl of golden liquid. The desk is covered with ancient books, potion bottles, scattered herbs and papers. Hanging magical lanterns in red, purple and gold light the scene with dramatic god rays filtering through the dense canopy above.
